identification: Half-round log section, light unfinished timber (looks like lime or pine), carved in deep relief inside an oval niche with a bust of an old man in a felt hat with a cord band, moustache, smoking a curved pipe. Scalloped top edge, tool-textured background. Unsigned in the photos. Mid to late 20th century Alpine/Bavarian or Polish (Zakopane-type) folk souvenir carving, 58 cm. Cloud scan correct.
